sv.title: Brasiliensmällen ger lägsta kursen sedan pandemin
sv.summary: Kursraset fortsätter i Better Collective som faller över 8 procent på rapporten – till den lägsta nivån sedan pandemibotten. Spelmarknadsföringsbyråns vd Jesper Søgaard lyfter i Di TV fram rekordomsättningen i kvartalet, men enligt analyshuset Jefferies räcker det inte.

en.title: Brazil crash sends shares to lowest level since pandemic
en.summary: The share slide continues at Better Collective, which falls over 8 percent on its report – to its lowest level since the pandemic low. Jesper Søgaard, CEO of the gambling marketing agency, highlights the record turnover in the quarter on Di TV, but according to the analysis firm Jefferies, it is not enough.
